equity_bridge.item: Investments in equity investees at book
equity_bridge.note: 2026-06-30 balance sheet; equity-method stakes whose share of income (FY2025 CNY 87m) sits below operating income and is therefore not in the EBITDA flows -- matching-asset rule
2026-06-30 balance sheet; flows are consolidated so the NCI stock is deducted once here

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 6.5% is less than half the revenue 5yr CAGR (14.3%) and EPS 5yr CAGR (16.0%). The divergence is explained, not alarming: ZTO returned CNY 3.8-5.6bn/yr in dividends and 1.0-3.8bn/yr in buybacks over the period, so book value compounds far below earnings. The equity CAGR is used as the conservative long-run anchor; the base path starts above it (guidance year) and decays below it.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC less deposit interest income). The 5-year owner-FCF CAGR is undefined because FY2020 owner FCF was negative (capex supercycle: 7.2bn capex on 25.2bn revenue). Owner-FCF 3yr CAGR (15.7%) is marginally above the reported 3yr (15.3%) because interest income grew slower than FCF -- SBC is not growing faster than cash flow here (0.5% of revenue, flat).

scenario_narratives.base: The anti-involution pricing floor annualises through 2026 and holds, but it does not widen margins because the revenue mix is shifting toward grossed-up key-account and e-commerce-return parcels. ZTO compounds revenue in the mid-to-high single digits for three years on ~6% industry volume growth plus share gains, then decays toward 2.5%. EBITDA margin sits at 27.5% -- between the FY2025 actual and the H1 2026 run-rate -- and capex normalises from 12% toward 7% of revenue as the hub and fleet build-out completes, which is where most of the FCF growth comes from. Cash tax ramps to the 25% statutory rate.
scenario_narratives.bull: The regulator-enforced end to below-cost pricing becomes the industry's own equilibrium: the four Tongda operators stop competing on price and the market stays rational after enforcement eases. ZTO's cost lead (gross margin ~2x SF, ~3x YTO/Yunda) converts into continued 1-2pp annual share gains and reverse-logistics scales into a higher-margin product line, taking the EBITDA margin back toward 30%. Growth holds at 7-10% through 2028 and the US$1.5bn buyback program keeps shrinking the count at a single-digit forward P/E.
scenario_narratives.bear: The margin recovery is a regulatory artefact. Once the State Post Bureau's attention moves on in 2027, J&T, Yunda and STO resume price-led share grabs, ASP gives back the 2026 gains, and Alibaba/PDD/Douyin steer more volume to Cainiao and in-house networks. Revenue stalls for two years and the EBITDA margin resets to 22%. In parallel the HFCAA/PCAOB detente or broader US-China capital restrictions re-emerge as an ADR overhang -- this is priced in the bear weight rather than in the WACC, so it is charged once.

valuation_philosophy.summary: ZTO is valued as a mature, cash-generative network operator whose per-share value now comes from capex normalisation and capital return rather than from parcel growth. The build deliberately holds the EBITDA margin below the FY2023-24 peak because the revenue that is growing fastest is grossed-up and lower-margin, strips the interest earned on a CNY 38bn treasury while adding that treasury back in net cash, treats the US$1.5bn 2031 convert as debt at face rather than as dilution, and caps the terminal multiple at today's 14-15x owner FCF so no re-rating is assumed. The bear weight is raised because both the margin tailwind (regulatory) and the listing venue (ADR) depend on political decisions outside the company's control.
key_risks_to_valuation: Anti-involution enforcement lapses and Tongda price wars resume: each 1pp of EBITDA margin is worth roughly CNY 575m of annual EBITDA on FY2026 revenue
E-commerce platforms (Alibaba/Cainiao, PDD, JD, Douyin) internalise or redirect parcel volume, shrinking the third-party addressable market
HFCAA / PCAOB inspection reversal or US investment restrictions on China ADRs force a delisting or a liquidity discount regardless of operating results
RMB depreciation: the valuation is in CNY and converted at spot; a 5% RMB move is a 5% move in the USD value with no operating offset

Treasury composition risk: CNY 28bn of the 38bn 'cash' is short- and long-term investments (deposits, wealth-management products, HTM securities); a haircut for onshore/trapped cash or product risk would reduce value roughly one-for-one
Convertible put in March 2029 (US$1.5bn at par) coincides with the bear-case margin trough; covered by the treasury but it is the one refinancing date in the model
Franchise-partner profitability disputes or service failures that interrupt volume at peak seasons

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API regular close at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 18.11-26.20. FX from Yahoo CNY=X at the time stamped in fx_note; parity check against HKEX 2057.HK.
data_sources.financials: FY2013-FY2025 annual history from ZTO_Metrics.csv (SEC XBRL companyfacts, currency corrected to CNY per ZTO_Corrections.jsonl); FY2025 component lines (SBC, deposit interest income, D&A, PP&E and land-use-right capex, cash tax paid, NCI, HTM securities, tax holidays) from us-gaap companyfacts for CIK 0001677250; 2026-06-30 balance sheet, H1 2026 income statement and cash flow, share count, convertible note terms and buyback detail from the 6-K filed 2026-08-19 (accession 0001104659-26-098506, Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2); post-June repurchases from the HKEX Next Day Disclosure Returns filed as 6-Ks on 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-28.
data_sources.qualitative: ZTO_Analysis.json (2026-10-04): business model, moat, bull/bear axes, FY2026 parcel-volume guidance 40.8-42.4bn (+6-10%), recent developments.

inputs.share_count_basis: 760,321,796 Class A+B ordinary shares outstanding at 2026-06-30 (Q2 2026 6-K balance sheet, treasury shares excluded) plus ~0.7m net RSU/option dilution (Q2 diluted 814.97m less basic 765.05m less 49.25m if-converted shares). The 2031 converts are NOT in the count: they are carried as debt at face in total_debt (conversion price ~US$30.46 vs the ADR price, capped call to US$35.99), so counting them would charge them twice. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows. HKEX Next Day Disclosure Returns show a further ~11.6m shares repurchased under the mandate between the AGM and 2026-09-22 (~1.5%); not applied because the matching cash outflow is after the 2026-06-30 balance sheet -- both move together at the next anchor refresh. 1 ADS = 1 ordinary share.
inputs.cash_composition: 2026-06-30, CNY m: cash and equivalents 9,906.9 + restricted cash 50.7 (44.6 current, 6.1 non-current) + short-term investments 21,400.9 (time deposits and wealth-management products) + long-term investments 6,520.5 (at 2025-12-31 this line was 87.6% held-to-maturity debt securities / term deposits per XBRL; treated as treasury). Equity-method investees are NOT here -- they sit in equity_bridge. Financing receivables to network partners (1,458.4) excluded: their yield is inside revenue.
inputs.debt_composition: 2026-06-30, CNY m: short-term bank borrowings 11,621.4 + long-term bank borrowings 17.0 + US$1.5bn 0.925% convertible senior notes due 2031-03-01 at FACE 10,380.0 (carrying 10,185.6 net of issuance costs; holders may put at par 2029-03-01). Operating lease liabilities (215.9) excluded -- lease cost is inside EBITDA (treatment B).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 20-F cash-flow statement add-back (us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation, CNY 229.25m). No separate equity-award tax line is disclosed (interim reconciliation footnote: 'net of income taxes of nil'); no combined figure published, so the add-back is used.
inputs.interest_income_source: us-gaap:InterestIncomeDepositsWithFinancialInstitutions FY2025 CNY 747.1m -- the interest earned on the treasury that is added back in net cash (cash + deposits + HTM; ~2.5% yield on ~CNY 30bn). The income-statement 'Interest income' tag (InvestmentIncomeInterest) shows 528.7m for FY2025 but 407.1m for H1 2025 alone, so the deposits tag is the one consistent with the balance sheet being bridged. Stripped because net cash (15.9bn) is 2.7x the owner-FCF base.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing-activity repurchases CNY 1,252.7m. 2026 YTD to Q2: 31.8m shares for US$740m incl. the 18.25m-share concurrent repurchase funded by the convert. Buybacks are value-neutral in this model (count held flat, SBC expensed) and are 5x SBC, so the flat count is funded, not a convention.
inputs.dividends_note: FY2025 dividends paid CNY 3,755.5m (FY2024: 5,605.5m). Policy: total shareholder return >= 50% of prior-year adjusted net income via dividends + buybacks; no H1 2026 interim dividend because buybacks already reached 52%.
inputs.fx_note: CNY -> USD 0.14915 (USD/CNY 6.7048, Yahoo CNY=X, 2026-10-04T03:30Z). Engine convention: model-currency per-share value x fx_rate = quote-currency value. Parity check against the HKEX dual listing 2057.HK (1 share = 1 ADS): HK$152.90 close 2026-10-02 / HKD peg 7.80-7.85 = US$19.48-19.60 vs the NYSE ADR close, a tie within 0.5%, which confirms the direction and the quote basis. All flows and the WACC are in CNY; only the final per-share values are converted.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-02T20:00:02Z regular close (Friday); valuation dated Saturday 2026-10-04, so this is the latest regular close, not an after-hours print
inputs.wacc_rationale: 9.0% in CNY for all three scenarios. Built from the flows' own currency: 10-year China government bond ~1.8%, China equity risk premium incl. country risk ~6.5%, beta ~0.9 for a domestic-demand logistics operator, plus a ~1.5pp allowance for the ADR/VIE structure, giving a cost of equity of ~9%; with CNY 15.9bn net cash and only ~1% all-in borrowing cost the WACC rounds to the cost of equity. Sits between the house USD-tech default (10.5%) and the JPY keiretsu reference (9%), which is where a lower risk-free rate and a higher ERP net out. Scenario risk (price wars, HFCAA, platform disintermediation) is charged ONCE, in the flows and the weights -- no per-scenario WACC spread and no stacked premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), operating cost. US GAAP filer: operating lease cost (FY2025 CNY 262m, 0.5% of revenue) is already inside cost of revenues/SG&A and therefore inside the EBITDA margin; operating lease liabilities (CNY 215.9m at 2026-06-30) are excluded from net debt. No finance leases of substance. No lease_cost_pct_path is needed because nothing is being moved out of EBITDA.
inputs.nci_treatment: Deducted once, in the bridge: non-controlling interests CNY 89.0m at 2026-06-30 (down from 752.1m at 2025-12-31 after a subsidiary buy-out in H1 2026). NCI share of profit was 1.7% of FY2025 net income and 1.2% in H1 2026; flows are left consolidated and the small stock is deducted. FY2025 check: modelled NOPAT at a 23% cash rate on EBIT 10,246 = 7,889 vs reported attributable net income 9,236 -- the gap is interest income (747, stripped), fair-value gains and a 17.2% GAAP rate, so the operating NOPAT ties.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company, express-delivery network), routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 2 (non-US operating company) with owner-fcf-adaptations.md applied: CNY-built WACC, reporting currency != quote currency with fx_note and HK parity check, leases treatment B, NCI charged once in the bridge, excluded interest income matched by the treasury added in net cash, equity-method stakes added at book because their income is below operating income. First valuation of this ticker (no memory entry, no prior DCF). HORIZON 10 years: growth is decelerating from a guidance-year ~17% to terminal 2.5% and capex intensity is still normalising from 12.4% to ~7% of revenue, so a 5-year terminal would capitalise an immature FCF margin. REVENUE QUALITY: H1 2026 revenue +22.5% on parcel volume +9.6% and ASP +15.5%; roughly half the ASP gain is the anti-involution pricing floor, the other half is mix -- key-account/reverse-logistics revenue (+63.6%) is grossed-up for last-mile fees paid to partners, so it adds revenue at a lower margin. That is why the EBITDA margin was 27.1% in H1 2026 against 28.7% in H1 2025 despite operating income +18%: the margin paths below are set on the new, lower-margin mix, not on the FY2023-24 33% peak. CAPEX basis: capex_pct covers purchases of property and equipment AND land-use rights (FY2025 5,214 + 860 = 6,074, 12.4% of revenue); the CSV FreeCashFlow (and hence reported_fcf/last_fcf) deducts PP&E only, so the component-built year-1 FCF is below last_fcf by design -- the land-use-right spend is real capex and is charged in the projection. WORKING CAPITAL: advances from customers (1,872.8) roughly offset receivables + financing receivables growth; FY2023-25 OCF-vs-earnings swings were +1.5bn/-0.9bn/-1.0bn with no trend, so wc_capture is 0. TAX: FY2025 cash tax paid 2,641.7 = 25.8% of EBIT / 23.9% of pretax; GAAP rate 17.2% flattered by a 536m deferred credit; H1 2026 7.7% because of a one-off 344m refund -- the path starts at 22% and ramps to the 25% PRC statutory rate as HNTE holidays (worth 1,114m in FY2025) and the dividend withholding tax on repatriation for buybacks bite. CONVERTS: US$1.5bn due 2031 treated as debt at face (deep out of the money at the current ADR price; capped call to US$35.99); if the shares ever trade above ~US$30.46 the if-converted 49.2m shares replace 10,380m of debt, which is approximately value-neutral at that price. SANITY: at the current price EV is ~CNY 81.6bn = 14.1x FY2025 owner FCF and 5.9x FY2025 EBITDA, so the 15x terminal cap assumes no re-rating. Price is the latest regular close, not after-hours.

bear.rationale: FY2026 still lands near +15% because H1 is banked, then the anti-involution enforcement lapses in 2027 and a price war resumes: ASP gives back most of the 2026 gain (revenue +1%/-1% in 2027-28) while volume keeps growing low-single-digit as Cainiao/JD Logistics internalise platform volume. EBITDA margin falls to 22% -- below the FY2021 price-war trough of 25.4% because today's grossed-up key-account mix carries a lower margin for the same unit profit. Capex intensity stays higher as the network still needs capacity for volume that is not being paid for.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +17%: H1 2026 actual +22.5% is banked (27,832m); H2 2025 (26,375m) already carried the anti-involution price floor from Q3 2025, so H2 2026 is modelled at ~+13% (volume guidance 6-10% plus a fading ASP tailwind). FY2027-29 7/6/5%: industry parcel volume growth of ~6% (management's own read) plus 1-2pp share gain, with flat ASP once the pricing floor has annualised. Decays to 2.5% by year 10, in line with China nominal GDP minus e-commerce maturity.
base.margin_rationale: 27.5% flat, below FY2025's 28.2% and well below the FY2023-24 33%+ peak: the grossed-up key-account/reverse-logistics mix structurally dilutes the margin (H1 2026 27.1% vs H1 2025 28.7%), offsetting the ASP recovery. Unit sorting + transport cost fell 2 fen in Q2 2026, which is what holds the margin flat rather than letting it slide. Does not assume the anti-involution floor widens margins further.
base.capex_rationale: PP&E + land-use rights: 17.4% FY2023, 13.3% FY2024, 12.4% FY2025, ~9.5% FY2026 (H1 2026 2.8bn vs 3.1bn). Hub and fleet build-out is largely complete; terminal 7.0% against 6.0% D&A funds 2.5% growth.
base.tax_rationale: Cash rate 22% -> 25%. FY2025 cash tax was 23.9% of pretax; HNTE 15% holidays (1,114m benefit FY2025) are renewable but not permanent, and PRC dividend withholding tax on repatriation for the US$1.5bn buyback program adds to the cash rate. The H1 2026 7.7% rate is a one-off refund and is not carried.

bull.rationale: Pricing discipline holds and becomes the industry norm after the regulator steps back; ZTO keeps taking 1-2pp share from YTO/STO/Yunda and reverse-logistics scales with better unit economics, lifting the EBITDA margin back toward 30% (still below the FY2023-24 peak). Growth stays high-single-digit through 2029. HNTE holidays renewed, so tax tops out at 24%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved from the 15/50/35 house default to 25/50/25. Bear up to 25% because the current earnings recovery rests on a single regulator's continued enforcement (a single-regulator dependency on ZTO's margin, not just on the industry) and because the ADR carries HFCAA/geopolitical delisting risk that no operating assumption captures. Bull down to 25% because it needs two independent things to hold at once -- pricing discipline surviving the end of active enforcement, AND volume growth re-accelerating despite a maturing e-commerce market that management itself has just guided down to 6-10%.
probability_weighted.band_note: band_position is not meaningful for ZTO and should be read as n/a: SBC is 0.4% of revenue, so the house/street band is only ~US$0.8/share wide (about 2.5% of value) and the current price sits far below both ends, which the formula reports as a large negative percentage. This is close to the SBC-zero case in owner-fcf-adaptations.md (e): the valuation does not depend on SBC treatment.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)

diagnosis.detail: Base year FCF 5,777.8 is 5.3x the historical median 1,080.2
Structural risks in the qualitative analysis that a standard WACC may not price: regulatory single point of failure

sanity_check_note.reason: sanity-check-fx-rate-direction-conflict (memory) -- sanity_check.py divides the USD quote by fx_rate (CNY->USD) instead of multiplying, so every FY-end price in the script-generated historical_table is wrong by fx_rate^2 (~45x). Recomputed by hand using the raw USD closes in ZTO_Prices.csv x (1/fx_rate) = CNY, matching dcf_engine.py convention.
sanity_check_note.verdict: genuine pass -- implied weighted-IV multiples (PE 17.95x, PB 2.50x, P/S 3.41x) sit within or below the 10yr CNY-correct historical range (PE 12.0-36.1x, PB 1.71-3.56x, P/S 2.34-6.43x); current-price multiples (PE 11.5x, PB 1.6x, P/S 2.2x) sit near the low end, consistent with the DCF upside rather than contradicting it. sanity_check.passed is left false per the documented template since the script itself produced the false trip, not the model.
